scientific_integrity: Fully stated analytic argument and a separate finite-size reproducibility script; finite checks do not establish infinite claims. No independent mathematical audit or external certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The two-term asymptotic is for the boundary-normalized directed ring position transition matrix, not arbitrary quantum internal-state fidelities or all normalization trajectories. The bound is asymptotic and independently unaudited. The first leading coefficient is consistent with the motivating paper's approximate expression, while the controlled second term and modulus ordering are new best-knowledge statements.
title: Sharp spectral relaxation at the admissibility boundary of a Dicke-state open quantum walk
